title: AI In Finance: Moving Beyond The Hype (BNP Paribas interview)
description: With thousands of companies keen to cash in on the hype around AI, it can be a bewildering, confusing field at the best of times - particularly when you factor in alarming statistics which suggest 40% of AI startups are not actually using AI. There's so much promise on the one hand, but on the other, there's a lack of maturity; in the technology, in business culture, in deployment strategy. Nowhere is this truer than for banks and financial services players.  To investigate how financial services firms can move beyond the hype of AI and start implementing and delivering successful AI projects, we caught up with Thierry Derungs, Chief Digital Officer for BNP Paribas Wealth Management, following his keynote at The AI Finance Summit in New York, 2018. In his role, Thierry develops and oversees the Digital Strategy for Wealth Management on a global level – providing country-based support for the deployment of all new projects. The Digital Strategy is not only about Web & Mobile solutions for clients & the public. It is also about improvements to employees' digital environment with commercial solutions (sales workstation on premises and in mobility, CRM, secured tablets) and others for efficiency (individual visio, collaborative site, webinar, eLearning) - and AI and machine learning sit firmly within this.  -------------  With flagship shows in San Francisco, London, New York, Munich, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Cape Town, 2019 will see over 30,000 delegates from businesses globally joining the AI revolution through The AI Summit events.  The AI Summit series uniquely has the support of tech's elite, with our 2018 Industry Partners featuring AWS, IBM Watson, Microsoft, Cisco, Oracle, Google, HCL, PwC, Publicis Sapient, Genpact, Intel alongside 300+ sponsors and partners. Exclusive, inspirational insights from acclaimed speakers are frequently reported by the world's foremost press including official media partners CBS, Reuters, BBC, The Times, Quartz, Tech Radar.

asr.full_text: I'm here with Thierry de Runge, Chief Disctional Officer for Wealth Management at BNB Paribas. Thierry, how's it going today? I'm pretty good! So I just work out from the stage and it was really a good session already so nice. What's a key takeaway for you for from the keynote? In fact, when you are discussing around artificial intelligence, there is a lot of hype. You have your peers, you have the next door CXO, consultant, telling you that yeah, you't go, your business will be blown away, so you cannot survive without that. Is it true, is it wrong? And that's really my topic, say, okay, what to do with all that information and the hype. To do something for real. So do you think the technology is kind of moving beyond the hype now now in your industry? Yeah, for show that many technologies on AI, because AI is a wide domain so it depends what you are looking exactly. The technology is pretty mature on many topics for AI. What is not really mature is let's say the business organization, the transformation itself, and being ready to work differently, change some business model, some approach that you have. So the challenge is, at my point of view, much more at business side than purely at technology. So what is it about the business culture that is stopping it right now. So it's perhaps a bit special for bank. Banks yes we love money for sure so yeah we love to have let's say very short business case long-term investment and saying okay just say I want to invest but tell me what will be my return in five years, when you are discovering artificial intelligence topic well you are discovering so it's almost impossible to tell what will be the return you have first two experiments and Having that capacity to to try in a very short cycle Learn before expanding. It's a huge Let's say transformation for the banks, especially It's really about working differently, so it sounds like kind of a big challenge game into grips with their so you know what what kind of your starting points for know starting to change that culture so yeah in my mission as a chief digital officer I also have a change management in awareness. So it's also my duty to meet the people, explain what's behind the different words, what the blockchain really means. It's not Bitcoin, it's a technology and so on. What natural language processing really means, what you can really expect from that. So not going to big dreams and things like that, because it will be soon turned into nightmare, if you do that. So, a lot of... really work on the soft skills from the people. Then it's also finding the right partners, internally and externally, onboard people like compliance, legal from the very first day together with the IT and the business and make all those people work together because as soon as you touch automation and artificial intelligence you are changing in depth the way you do business and to do that you need everyone onboard so that's really the key message on board all those people and work together on the topic. Absolutely and I mean, there's a lot of Fintech start-ups right now and so called like Challenger banks who are working with AI. How much do you see them as kind of a threat to traditional financial services organizations or do they complement this ecosystem and kind of help you leverage those technologies? Yeah, that's again a hype from consulting firms saying, Okay fintech will still hold your business, yes for sure, there is a rebalance of the business between new actors and so on, but, we lose everything, really not. The best way to move on, to go to the future, is to work with the FinTech and that's what we do. We work with many startups and FinTech and doing project all together. The partnership is really fine, everyone is happy, it's a win win. And yeah, we are not off-business. We are still there. We have a very strong vision of the future. And we are working on that altogether. Again, it's a collaborative work. Yeah. OK absolutely and what are you... what are you looking forward to engaging with today at the event here? Yeah, as you can guess, I love to discuss with people, with peers, from from other bands but also with people involved in digital from other industries. My son is in help, working in a startup on the virtual reality in help, so that's another topic still still digital so I like that. So to meet people, exchange, meet new startup, that's the perfect place to do that, in my day to day work, if I have to meet 10 startups, it will take me one or two months because of the agenda. Here it will take me the or two months because of the agenda. Here it will take me the morning. So that's perfect to discover and get in contact. Absolutely. Well, Thierry, thanks for talking to me today. My pleasure. Enjoy. Thank you.
